race.title: Hobgoblin Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: ORDEROFTHEDAY ought to relish this step back up in trip, and he's taken to make it 2 wins from 3 starts over fences. Kahavari will be suited by speed-favouring conditions and just edges Kalhandrion for next best. ORDEROFTHEDAY (IRE) KAHAVARI (FR) KALHANDRION (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Kalhandrion (3/1), Orderoftheday (4/1), Seven Kites (5/1), Warriors Destiny (6/1), Torrent (7/1), Shy Love (8/1), Kahavari (10/1), Stone's Throw (12/1)
